name: io.github.capsulatedev/capsulate
description: Real Linux and Windows desktop VMs for AI agents: exec, files, computer-use and snapshots via MCP.

environmentVariables.name: CAPSULATE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A cap_live_ API key from the dashboard (Settings → API & Keys).

environmentVariables.name: CAPSULATE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://api.capsulate.dev.

environmentVariables.name: CAPSULATE_TEAM_ID
environmentVariables.description: Team to bill. Defaults to the API key's team.
